method: Final acceptance harnesses sequential, after million-case oracle, release gate build/test and other authored CPU workloads finished. 10000 warmup, 11 rounds x 100000 calls per case, fixed order. Median ns/call is the acceptance statistic; min/max batch means retained. Shared host; not a worst-case individual-call latency proof.
compiler: Rust 1.58.1 Cargo release library and rustc -O benchmark harness
